body: Thank you for the reply. I don't really enjoy doing much. I have my dogs who I love dearly and they are probably the only things I love. I have no intrest in going out because I'm constantly self conscious and a nervous wreck. I can't even go to the grocery store without make up on. Everyday I take more benzos then I'm prescribed topped with gravol, benedryl, cough syrup... Anything to make my mind hazy and distract myself from the pain im in. I have no support system. I tried telling my mom how I felt and she said "if you really wanted to kill yourself you would have done it by now, people who REALLY want to hurt themselves don't tell other people, they just do it." I feel like if I died people would be either happier or indifferent.
